# OpenAgenticSecurity / agentic-sdlc

> Lean, agent-native Agentic SDLC standards, Secure Vibe Coding guardrails, 8 empirical & readiness checklists, progressive L0–L2 adoption kits, 6 standalone language-agnostic Agent Skills, reusable `action.yml`, starter gates, and fail-closed verification scripts.
> Core thesis: Agent output is an untrusted draft by default. Let Coding Agents carry workflow ergonomics (`skills/`, `profiles/`, `checklists/`); let deterministic hooks, `deps`, and protected GitHub Rulesets carry the trust boundary.

## Fast Routing Map for Coding Agents

Read ONLY the file(s) matching your current task:

- **Bootstrap Agentic SDLC into a user's repo (`L0` / `L1` / `L2`)**:
  - Skill: `skills/bootstrap-agentic-sdlc/SKILL.md`
  - Guide & workflow map: `BOOTSTRAP.md` (`BOOTSTRAP.zh.md`), `docs/workflow-integration.md`
  - Templates: `profiles/L0-solo/`, `profiles/L1-team/` (`workflows/ci-{python,node-ts,rust,go,java}.yml`), `profiles/L2-governed/` (`github-ruleset.import.json`)
  - Pure-Bash bootstrap (never overwrites): `scripts/bootstrap.sh --profile <L0|L1|L2> [--ci python|node-ts|rust|go|java] --target <repo>`
  - Read-only check: `scripts/check-product-compliance.sh --profile <L0|L1|L2> <repo>`

- **Write or review security-, reliability- & performance-sensitive AI code**:
  - Skill: `skills/secure-vibe-coding/SKILL.md`
  - Standards & checklist: `standards/secure-vibe-coding.md`, `standards/reliable-and-performant-coding.md`, `checklists/secure-vibe-coding-review.md`

- **Audit a PR / git diff before merge**:
  - Skill: `skills/audit-pr-diff/SKILL.md`
  - Checklists: `checklists/vibe-coding-seven-sins.md`, `checklists/frontend-vibe-coding-review.md`, `checklists/backend-performance-review.md`, `profiles/L2-governed/mechanism-review-checklist.md`
  - Starter E2E & backend contract gates: `examples/frontend-3layer-gate.spec.ts`, `examples/backend-contract-gates.py`

- **Audit full-repo production readiness (Demo vs Production, 5 dimensions)**:
  - Skill: `skills/audit-production-readiness/SKILL.md`
  - Checklist: `checklists/production-readiness-audit.md` (7 evidence disciplines, 3-layer defaults, data liveness, H1/H2 verdict)

- **Verify completion & enforce fail-closed non-self-attestation**:
  - Skill: `skills/done-claim-verify/SKILL.md`
  - Checklist & templates: `checklists/fake-done-dereference.md`, `checklists/done-claim.template.md`, `checklists/done-claim.example.json`

- **Coordinate multi-agent Git worktrees, Issue Claims, handoffs & workspace ops**:
  - Skill: `skills/multi-agent-git-flow/SKILL.md`
  - Checklists & template: `checklists/multi-agent-git-gates.md`, `checklists/agent-ops-and-workspace-hygiene.md`, `checklists/handoff.template.md`
  - Scripts: `scripts/workspace-git.py`, `scripts/agent-claim.py`, `scripts/link-shared-node-deps.mjs`

- **Instant read-only self-audit, coupled-change sync & evals (zero pip install)**:
  - Self-audit: `python3 scripts/audit-repo.py <repo> [--github]` | Reusable CI: `action.yml`
  - Coupled-change sync: `python3 scripts/check-change-sync.py --config profiles/L1-team/agentic-sync.example.json --base <base> --head <head>`
  - Offline evals: `scripts/run-evals.py`, `evals/`

- **Strict L2 GitHub Ruleset observer**:
  - `scripts/observe-github-ruleset.py --live --repo <owner/repo> --ruleset-id <id> --policy profiles/L2-governed/ruleset-policy.example.json --validate`

- **Ontology, versioning, evidence & sibling enforcement**:
  - `docs/ontology.md` (9 entities / 5 axioms), `standards/versioning-and-releases.md`, `MATURITY.md`, `docs/empirical-findings.md`, `docs/manifesto.md`
  - Sibling repos: `OpenAgenticSecurity/deps`, `OpenAgenticSecurity/sealed-data`, `OpenAgenticSecurity/assurance-contracts`
